column1: # add a numbered migration (<dir>/NNNN_<name>.sql) whose NNNN is already on the
# base under another file name or in a file another open PR adds and that PR
# keeps (it holds the reservation, or neither holds it and it is older; else a
# NOTE, so only one of the two renumbers). Only projects
# with a migrations_glob.<project> settings row are checked; the PR's project is
# the fleet.conf row whose column 2 is the repo's origin slug ($PSC_PROJECT
# wins). bin/lib/migration-number.sh (mn_psc_check) has the rule. param and
# match are unused (-). Set the mode to note or off to turn the refusal off.

column4: a new migration whose NNNN is on main or in another open PR (BH-7325)
